At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.64 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Highway 129
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 3.4 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 834 to 880 ft, with 333 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 87°F.
